query: WITH features AS (SELECT a.id, a.outlet, a.feed, COALESCE(a.ingestion_run_id, 'untagged') AS ingestion_run_id, date_trunc('month', a.published_at)::date AS published_month, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(a.claims), 0) AS claim_count, COALESCE(bool_or(c.id IS NOT NULL), false) AS has_citation, COALESCE(bool_or((item->>'kind') = 'substantive'), false) AS has_substantive, COALESCE(bool_or((item->>'kind') = 'framing'), false) AS has_framing FROM public.articles a LEFT JOIN public.citations c ON c.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(a.claims, '[]'::jsonb)) AS item ON true GROUP BY a.id, a.outlet, a.feed, a.ingestion_run_id, a.published_at, a.claims), classified AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN has_substantive AND has_framing AND has_citation THEN 'fully_extracted' WHEN has_substantive OR has_framing OR has_citation THEN 'partially_extracted' ELSE 'extraction_absent' END AS extraction_class FROM features), rows AS (SELECT 'run'::text AS segment, ingestion_run_id AS label, extraction_class FROM classified UNION ALL SELECT 'outlet', outlet, extraction_class FROM classified UNION ALL SELECT 'feed', feed, extraction_class FROM classified UNION ALL SELECT 'month', COALESCE(published_month::text, 'undated'), extraction_class FROM classified) SELECT segment, label, count(*) AS articles, count(*) FILTER (WHERE extraction_class = 'fully_extracted') AS fully_extracted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE extraction_class = 'partially_extracted') AS partially_extracted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE extraction_class = 'extraction_absent') AS extraction_absent FROM rows GROUP BY segment, label HAVING count(*) >= CASE WHEN segment = 'outlet' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ORDER BY segment, articles DESC, label LIMIT 250;
